verdict.rationale: Mesh can be driven headlessly through its own API. Scoped API credentials with permissions and expiry are generated for programmatic access, and the API covers synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening. Webhooks such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED report results, cases and alerts can be remediated via the API, and a downloadable OpenAPI schema, Postman collection and rate-limit headers support unattended automation. Missing for 10: official CLI, CI-specific guidance or a sandbox/test environment, and hands-on or independent corroboration of an authenticated automated run.
